name: djinn-codex
description: Codex adapter for the djinn code review relay. Built from plugins/djinn in the djinn-relay repo, which stays the only edited source. Skills: djinn-setup, djinn-review (quick and standard), djinn-status, djinn-view.

interface.shortDescription: The djinn code review relay, for Codex
interface.longDescription: Multi-agent code review: a team of review agents reads your branch against its base and a synthesis agent merges what they found into one verdict, in an audit folder you can open in the browser. Run $djinn-review in any git repo; the first run sets djinn up. Brief, dispatch and learn are not on Codex yet; see adapters/codex/PLAN.md.
defaultPrompt: Use $djinn-review quick to audit this branch's change
Use $djinn-status to show what is still open in the latest audit
Use $djinn-view to open this repo's audits in my browser
